recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy portrait of a male figure in a mid-performance shout, rendered with aggressive, multi-colored oil and acrylic brushstrokes against a textured black background, featuring prominent neon-yellow graffiti-style lettering in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant primary-colored highlights against a deep matte black void
Rough, gestural paint strokes defining anatomical structure
Fluid, spray-painted typography overlapping the central subject
Distressed, worn paper texture applied to the overall composition
coreInvariants: Black background with subtle paper-edge distressing
Triadic color palette of yellow, cyan, and red-orange highlights
Subject's arm raised in a triumphant gesture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical figure, cropped from the waist up, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and facial expression of the subject, highlighted with bright cyan and red.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the raised arm, follows down the body to the large yellow lettering, then settles on the smaller secondary text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the figure to emphasize the 'glow' of the paint.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Vermillion (Facial and Body Contours)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black base and high-chroma, high-value highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Varying stroke thickness mimicking a spray paint nozzle
Long, sweeping descenders and horizontal flourishes
Soft, rounded terminals with occasional paint drip effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final letter extends into a long horizontal underline beneath the word
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, large-scale graffiti script paired with a clean, wide-tracked minimalist sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, urban energy of the primary title.
Provides a clean, modern contrast for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a neo-expressionist digital painting of a man shouting with one arm raised. Use thick, visible brushstrokes in cyan, yellow, and red to define highlights on his face and body. The background must be a solid, textured matte black with worn paper edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, neon-yellow graffiti-style hand-lettering across the lower third, overlapping the figure. Include a long horizontal stroke underlining the text. Below that, add the secondary text in a white, thin, wide-spaced sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure matte black?
Are the brushstrokes visible and gestural?
Does the yellow text have a spray-painted quality?
Is the secondary text widely tracked?

adjustableVariables: Level of paper distressing on edges
Specific colors used for facial highlights
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Unique hand-drawn ligatures in the script
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic realism; maintain painterly style.
Check that the yellow text is the brightest element.
Verify the distressed border doesn't obscure the text.
Confirm the triadic color scheme is balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Neo-expressionist portrait + matte black void + neon graffiti overlay + distressed paper texture.
